Welshpool, Full Time, Science & Technology
Vacancy Listing Dates 9/07/2026 to 6/08/2026
Please Quote Reference Number 16958
- Skilled Site Services Environmental Advisor wanted
- Full time opportunity - FIFO
- Join the team at Plus Pumps Australia

Plus Pumps offers expert dredging consulting equipment and services, as well as industrial pump sales and repair. Committed to excellence, Plus Pumps provides cutting-edge solutions for the construction, mining, dredging, dewatering, water treatment, and a variety of other heavy industrial sectors.

We are currently seeking a Site Services Environmental Advisor to join our team in a FIFO role. Our head office is based in Welshpool.

Applicants must have 2+ years' experience in a similar role and hold a relevant qualification.

Responsibilities:
- Assist Plus Pumps management with the tendering process for projects to ensure all environmental aspects are covered.
- Work with Plus Pumps client’s premobilisation for the environmental components of projects through mining and marine sectors.
- Monitor environmental performance during dredging and pump operations across mine sites and projects throughout Australia.
- Ensure monitoring tools are maintained and calibrated.
- Carry out daily environmental inspections on dredge units, pumps, pipelines, hose connections, bunding and spill areas.
- Report all environmental observations, monitoring data and incidents in written reports to the Plus Pumps Operations Manager and site environmental teams.
- Support pump setup and pipeline checks identifying environmental risks such as leaks, spills or sediment disturbance and ensure compliance with environmental limits and license conditions.
- Assist with risk assessments (JHAs/JSAs) and recommend environmental controls for dredging and pump maintenance.
- Assist Plus Pumps management with completion of projects to ensure all environmental compliance aspects are met.

A salary of $110,000 - $130,000 will be offered to the successful candidate.

Apply now through our online application form -
https://www.netyourjob.com.au/jobs/16958.php

Sponsorship may be available to the right person.
